q: Which payment methods are growing fastest this month compared to last month? Show percentage growth.
sql: SELECT payment_method, COALESCE(((SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND transaction_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) - 1), 0) AS growth_percentage FROM silver_transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 2 MONTH)) AND transaction_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND payment_method IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC;

q: Which 5 merchants have the highest refund rate? Show refund count and total transaction count.
sql: SELECT m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name, SUM(CASE WHEN st.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count, COUNT(st.transaction_id) AS total_transaction_count, (SUM(CASE WHEN st.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(st.transaction_id), 0)) AS refund_rate FROM merchants m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT merchant_id, transaction_id, status FROM silver_transactions WHERE quality_flag = 'PASS' AND transaction_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') st ON m.merchant_id = st.merchant_id GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 5;
